installer.toolchain: Inno Setup 6 source is included for reproducible local test builds; the compiler itself is not redistributed.
installer.acceptanceEvidence: Owner-reported completion for preceding acceptance candidate; not independently observed or attested against final release hash.

runtime.api: Bundle CPython 3.13.x with the locked API wheels and the ready-to-run LabViz API environment.
runtime.web: Bundle Node.js 22.22.2 or newer with the Next.js standalone server and static assets.

upgradePolicy.database: Keep the SQLite database and local objects outside the program directory.
upgradePolicy.upgrade: Install a new immutable program directory and retain local data by default.
upgradePolicy.rollback: Keep the previous program version until the new health check succeeds.
upgradePolicy.uninstall: Ask whether to retain or delete data; never delete it silently.

exclude: development node_modules outside the traced V2.0/web production runtime
